verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is a SaaS research and notebook service, not an agent acting as an MCP client, so shipping an official MCP server is plausible and the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents in-app features: sources, chat, citations, overviews, sharing and exports. Nothing in it mentions an MCP server, an API, or any programmatic agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
